content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 identifies this service as bundled into another paid service, so the denied balance is a contractual adjustment rather than patient responsibility; deductible and coinsurance do not make it patient-billable. Two peer-to-peer requests and an appeal have already failed to resolve the denial, and similar claims had no payments after 20 additional peer-to-peer requests. With no documented coding error, no separate payable balance, and no secondary payer, further rework is unsupported and the remaining balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
